title: Module 4 - Financial Statement Analysis and Financial Modeling

assets.alt_text: Financial modeling map linking the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and equity while separating reported, reclassified, normalized, and forecast evidence layers.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 PNG, 16:9. Academic three-statement modeling map for Module 4. Link the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, and equity roll-forward with explicit directional arrows and a final balance and cash reconciliation check. Show that operating-balance, fixed-asset, and debt schedules feed the cash bridge, and that closing cash returns to the balance sheet. Above the statements, show four evidence layers in order: reported, reclassified, normalized, forecast. Keep labels short and exact. Off-white background, navy linework, teal operating links, muted-blue balance-sheet links, amber forecast highlights, coral control-break warnings, and a 7% safe margin. No company logos, fake filings, or invented numbers.
production_notes: Generated from code so accounting identities, layer order, and reconciliation dependencies remain exact.
Forecast is amber and coral is reserved for a failed control; long definitions remain in the chapter.
The reverse balance-to-cash dependency makes working-capital, fixed-asset, and debt schedule feedback explicit.

assets.alt_text: Two-lane driver map comparing the DuPont components of return on equity with the operating-margin and capital-turnover components of return on invested capital.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 two-lane academic driver map. The ROE lane shows net margin 9.00%, asset turnover 1.307×, and equity multiplier 1.811× combining to ROE 21.30%. The ROIC lane shows after-tax operating margin 11.25% and capital turnover 1.688× combining to ROIC 18.99%. Use large labels, an off-white background, teal operating links, muted-blue capital links, amber comparison accents, and no decorative or invented data.
production_notes: Every displayed value is derived from the lesson simulation inputs and checked against the defining ROE or ROIC identity before rendering.
The two lanes prevent readers from treating ROE and ROIC as interchangeable return measures.

assets.alt_text: Waterfall chart reconciling reported EBIT of USD 120 million through a plant-closure add-back, land-sale gain removal, and routine software cost to normalized EBIT of USD 122 million.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 academic waterfall chart in USD millions: reported EBIT 120, plant-closure add-back +18, land-sale gain removal -10, routine software cost -6, normalized EBIT 122. State that stock compensation has zero adjustment and remains in operating expense. Use large labels, an off-white background, semantic book colors, and no fabricated evidence.
production_notes: The chart is a deterministic rendering of the signed pretax bridge in Lesson 4.3.
Tax treatment is deliberately excluded from the chart and explained in the adjacent text.

assets.alt_text: Two-lane entity-perimeter map showing financial assets under IFRS 9, significant influence under IAS 28, joint arrangements under IFRS 11, control and consolidation under IFRS 10, NCI attribution, and structured-entity exposure and support disclosure under IFRS 12.
assets.prompt: Create a deterministic 1920x1080 academic map with two distinct lanes and no quantitative data. In the accounting-route lane, show four parallel classifications: financial asset under IFRS 9; significant influence and the equity method under IAS 28; joint arrangement based on rights and obligations under IFRS 11; and control with consolidation under IFRS 10. In the economic-exposure lane, connect a structured entity to guarantees or liquidity support and then to disclose-and-stress analysis under IFRS 12; separately connect control to NCI attribution across profit, OCI, and equity claims. Use large labels, an off-white background, semantic book colors, and restrained arrows only where a dependency exists.
production_notes: The accounting classifications are parallel routes rather than a sequential process.
The lower lane makes residual guarantees, liquidity support, structured-entity exposure, and NCI attribution visible without inventing amounts.
The figure is an author-created instructional schematic; the adjacent lesson provides the authoritative standards references.

assets.alt_text: Waterfall chart reconciling beginning cash of USD 60 million through operating cash flow, capital expenditures, debt repayment, and dividends paid to ending cash of USD 86.05 million.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 academic cash waterfall in USD millions: beginning cash 60, CFO +146.05, capital expenditures -70, debt repayment -20, dividends paid -30, ending cash 86.05. Use large labels, an off-white background, teal operating inflow, restrained coral outflows, muted-blue totals, and explicit sign labels.
production_notes: The waterfall reproduces the Lesson 4.5 cash identity under zero FX effect and identical statement cash scopes.
Dividends declared equal dividends paid only within the stated simulation assumptions.
